tests.name: Hemoglobin
tests.low_meaning: A lower hemoglobin result may be associated with reduced oxygen-carrying capacity; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher hemoglobin result can have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: WBC
tests.low_meaning: A lower white blood cell count may affect how the body responds to infection; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher white blood cell count may occur for several reasons; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: RBC
tests.low_meaning: A lower red blood cell count may affect oxygen delivery; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher red blood cell count can have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Platelets
tests.low_meaning: A lower platelet count may affect blood clotting; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher platelet count may have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Glucose
tests.low_meaning: A lower glucose result may be important to review with your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher glucose result may be important to review with your doctor.

tests.name: Cholesterol
tests.low_meaning: A lower total cholesterol result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher total cholesterol result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: LDL
tests.low_meaning: A lower LDL result is usually interpreted with other health information; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher LDL result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: HDL
tests.low_meaning: A lower HDL result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher HDL result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Creatinine
tests.low_meaning: A lower creatinine result can have several explanations; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher creatinine result may be related to kidney function; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: TSH
tests.low_meaning: A lower TSH result may relate to thyroid activity; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher TSH result may relate to thyroid activity; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: HbA1c
tests.low_meaning: A lower HbA1c result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher HbA1c result may reflect higher average blood sugar; please consult your doctor.
